findings.description: OI_EXPANSION was triggered solely by ATR expansion ratio (> 1.35) without requiring or verifying open interest data.
findings.remediation: Rename to VOLATILITY_EXPANSION. Only emit OI_EXPANSION when verified open-interest data exists.

findings.description: OI_UNWIND was triggered solely by ATR compression ratio (<= 0.65) and flat slope without open interest data.
findings.remediation: Rename to RANGE_COMPRESSION / VOLATILITY_COMPRESSION. Explicitly report oi_state = 'UNAVAILABLE'.

findings.description: LIQUIDITY_STRESS was triggered solely by realized volatility >= 0.85 or 2h drawdown >= 3.5% without order book depth or spread metrics.
findings.remediation: Rename to MARKET_STRESS. Reserve LIQUIDITY_STRESS for periods with verified order book depth or spread deterioration.

findings.description: Single mutually exclusive MarketRegime enum erased multi-dimensional market state (e.g. extreme funding obscured trend).
findings.remediation: Refactor into multi-dimensional compositional MarketState dataclass preserving all dimensions simultaneously.

findings.description: FUNDING_EXTREME_ABS = 0.0004 commented as '40 bps / 8h'. However 0.0004 = 4 bps (0.04%), whereas 40 bps = 0.0040 (0.40%).
findings.remediation: Correct threshold to 30 bps (0.0030) based on empirical funding distribution and create unit-safe conversion helpers.

findings.description: Placeholder pbo_val = 0.50 was hardcoded during per-strategy promotion evaluation rather than computed from the candidate variant search space.
findings.remediation: Calculate CSCV PBO across the actual parameter variant matrix of each strategy family.

findings.description: compute_pbo_cscv silently returned 0.0 on insufficient inputs, creating the false appearance of zero overfitting probability.
findings.remediation: Return explicit PBO_NOT_COMPUTABLE / null with diagnostic reason codes when uncomputable.

findings.description: Hardcoded var_sr = 0.25 cross-sectional Sharpe variance assumption in DSR calculation rather than evidence-based estimation.
findings.remediation: Compute empirical cross-sectional variance across the actual explored variant universe.

findings.description: Single 15-day train / 15-day test split on 1 month of data. High-frequency 1m horizon caused severe friction churn.
findings.remediation: Compile multi-year canonical dataset (2021-2024), implement rolling walk-forward validation with dynamic purging & embargo, and research lower-turnover horizons.

findings.description: Cost model used lump-sum turnover without separating exchange fees, spread, slippage, and point-in-time funding cash flows.
findings.remediation: Create audited cost policy layer with exact point-in-time funding payments crossing 8-hour boundaries.

findings.description: Docstring labeled fixed-length moving block bootstrap (k=5) as 'stationary block bootstrap'.
findings.remediation: Accurately name function run_moving_block_bootstrap and implement sensitivity checks across block lengths.

findings.description: Scattered decimal constants without dedicated unit conversion utilities.
findings.remediation: Implement unit-safe conversion helpers with exact Decimal precision and comprehensive tests.

findings.description: Policy v1.0.0 lacked multi-year consistency, regime breakdown criteria, and NOT_COMPUTABLE state handling.
findings.remediation: Upgrade policy to Version 2.0.0 with explicit multi-year and statistical requirements.

findings.description: Deterministic logical SHA-256 calculation across records is sound and verified.
findings.remediation: Retain as canonical dataset identity standard.

findings.description: SQLite WAL persistence and permanent experiment tracking correctly recorded all 7 Round 1 failures without deletion.
findings.remediation: Retain; preserve Round 1 records without overwriting.

findings.description: Point-in-time verification via future perturbation and truncated history equivalence tests is sound.
findings.remediation: Retain and enforce for all future features.

findings.description: Security scanner correctly verified TRADING CAPABILITY = ZERO with 0 hits on forbidden mutation endpoints.
Zero forced promotion upheld: all 7 Round 1 strategies were rejected, and APPROVED_FOR_PAPER = 0 was maintained.
findings.remediation: Inviolable scientific honesty invariant; maintain in Round 2.
